items.title: Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1969-12-14
items.q: I think Patty Orman's dead now.

ctx.x: You know, I want to ask you a question at this point. Whatever happened to the mute on the cornet and the trumpet? That's just passe, huh? But it sure sounded good. No, no.

It's still being used, but not, not as much as it, as it was before. Uh, you see, Joe Oliver used it in a way which was extremely effective, and none of our northern brethren know about that. The only thing the northern brethren know, uh, excuse me, people. Watch it now. We've got a lot of those Yankees in the city. Yeah, I know. I'm going to get it. Uh, well, they, they used a plunger, you know, which is oh so naughty and dirty. They put a mute in there, and then they put a plunger. Well, Joe Oliver didn't do…
Not only that, it's all being taped. Good morning. You're on the air.
